title: How do you get accurate colors in product photography?
h1: How do you get accurate colors in product photography? 🎨
metaTitle: 📷 Get accurate colors with Alphashot Pro G2
description: Read this guide to find out how Orbitvu automated photo studios help you get true-to-life visuals. Optimize your content creations and product visuals, internally and in a few minutes.
tool: Orbitvu Station software and a lipstick
introText:
When you buy online, the color of a product plays a key role in the purchase decision. A poorly reproduced color can disappoint the customer and lead to returns. To avoid this, it is essential to have an optimized shooting process.

In this guide, learn how to use Orbitvu solutions to create accurate and consistent visuals, using the example of a lipstick. 💄

This tutorial was done using the Studio Alphashot Pro G2, the first automated photo studio with a built-in AI assistant. 🤖

‍

steps.content:
Before you start, place the lipstick in the center of the studio turntable for consistent visuals from every angle. A good positioning from the start guarantees an optimal result. 🎯

steps.title: Light settings
steps.content:
One of the major advantages of the Alphashot Pro G2 is its intelligent lighting management system. 💡

Click on the AI icon, the assistant will scan your product and will offer you several predefined templates adapted to your type of product. 🤖
steps.structuredText: One of the major assets of Orbitvu is its intelligent lighting management system. It offers several predefined templates (or templates) adapted to each type of product. Brilliant finish: a template that accentuates reflections to enhance the brilliance of the product. Matt effect: softer and more diffuse lighting that prevents reflections. The AI automatically adjusts the lighting according to the chosen template, so you don't have to waste time on manual settings.

faqs.question: How do you ensure that colors stay true when printing a catalog?
faqs.answer: When exporting, use a high resolution format (TIFF or PNG) with a color profile suitable for printing (CMYK). Work closely with your printer to calibrate the entire graphics chain.

faqs.question: How does better color accuracy impact the profitability of my e-commerce?
faqs.answer: True shades reduce the risk of returns due to customer disappointment. Fewer returns mean fewer logistics costs and better satisfaction, both of which directly improve the profit margin.

faqs.question: Do you need special knowledge to calibrate colors?
faqs.answer: No, the AI Photo Assistant automatically adjusts the lighting to ensure accurate color accuracy. You can fine-tune these settings as needed, but most users get good results without advanced technical training.

faqs.question: How many shots can you shoot in a day with the Alphashot Pro G2?
faqs.answer: This depends on the complexity of the products, but thanks to automation and batch management, you can easily capture several hundred visuals per day, where a traditional studio would produce a lot fewer.
